name: AIENG Shared Normative Integration

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - automation/aieng-shared-docs-20260907
    paths:
      - .github/workflows/aieng-shared-docs.yml

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  integrate:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout reconciliation baseline
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          ref: 7fcbd3d64cf4cb158f1ead98c56131015be887e9

      - name: Configure Git identity
        run: |
          git config user.name "Monad EOS Automation"
          git config user.email "eos-automation@users.noreply.github.com"

      - name: Fetch source history
        run: git fetch origin eosp/ai-driven-engineering-operating-model

      - name: Reconcile ADR index
        run: |
          python3 - <<'PY'
          from pathlib import Path
          path = Path('architecture/decisions/README.md')
          text = path.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
          anchor = '| [`ADR-0006`](ADR-0006-eos-sovereignty-and-external-sdlc-assimilation.md) | EOS Sovereignty and External SDLC Assimilation | Accepted | 2026-08-13 | — |'
          rows = [
              '| [`ADR-0007`](ADR-0007-governed-execution-harness.md) | Governed Execution Harness Architecture | Proposed | 2026-09-01 | — |',
              '| [`ADR-0008`](ADR-0008-ai-driven-engineering-as-default-eos-operating-model.md) | AI-Driven Engineering as the Default EOS Operating Model | Accepted | 2026-09-05 | — |',
          ]
          if anchor not in text:
              raise SystemExit('ADR-0006 index anchor not found')
          insertion = anchor + '\n' + '\n'.join(row for row in rows if row not in text)
          text = text.replace(anchor, insertion, 1)
          path.write_text(text, encoding='utf-8')
          PY

      - name: Replay approved requirement delta
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          git diff --binary \
            660860197d63d932716f1cfe0a4132fbdc549f71 \
            76d42f7de053a16f316f4d3bf1f7702446269fe3 \
            -- product/product-requirements.md \
            | git apply --whitespace=fix

      - name: Reconcile approved specification baseline
        run: |
          python3 - <<'PY'
          from pathlib import Path
          import subprocess

          source = subprocess.check_output(
              ['git', 'show', 'origin/eosp/ai-driven-engineering-operating-model:specifications/baseline.md'],
              text=True,
          )
          source = source.replace('---------------------', '---', 1)
          marker = '## Known Machine-Traceability Identity Gap'
          if marker in source:
              source = source.split(marker, 1)[0].rstrip() + '''\n\n## Machine-Traceability Identity Reconciliation\n\nThe identifier-family mismatch recorded during the original AIENG baseline review was resolved by `MNT-0005`. Repository-native Requirement identifiers (`FR-*`, `QR-*`, and `REQ-*`) and Specification identifiers (`FUN-*`, `IFC-*`, `SEC-*`, `TECH-*`, `DATA-*`, `MKE-*`, and `SPEC-*`) are first-class canonical identities of their existing entity type. Existing governed identifiers were preserved; no alias namespace or renumbering was introduced.\n\nDedicated verification is recorded in `engineering/reviews/MNT-0005-IDENTITY-RESOLUTION-VERIFICATION.md`, and human closure authority is recorded in `engineering/reviews/DECISION-0008-2026-09-05-mnt-0005-closure-approval.md`.\n\nThe original finding `AIENG-TRC-001` is therefore **RESOLVED**. This resolution does not itself authorize AIENG runtime implementation.\n'''
          source = source.replace('| `FUN-AIENG-0001` | Functional | Adaptive engineering pathway, clarification, replanning, and workflow progression | Draft          |', '| `FUN-AIENG-0001` | Functional | Adaptive engineering pathway, clarification, replanning, and workflow progression | Approved       |')
          source = source.replace('| `IFC-AIENG-0001` | Interface  | Provider-neutral engineering-agent interaction contract                           | Draft          |', '| `IFC-AIENG-0001` | Interface  | Provider-neutral engineering-agent interaction contract                           | Approved       |')
          source = source.replace('| `SEC-AIENG-0001` | Security   | Autonomy, authority, delegation, approval, revocation, and fail-closed boundaries | Draft          |', '| `SEC-AIENG-0001` | Security   | Autonomy, authority, delegation, approval, revocation, and fail-closed boundaries | Approved       |')
          Path('specifications/baseline.md').write_text(source, encoding='utf-8')
          PY

      - name: Append AI-driven lifecycle and governance sections
        run: |
          python3 - <<'PY'
          from pathlib import Path
          import subprocess

          source_ref = 'origin/eosp/ai-driven-engineering-operating-model'
          targets = {
              'engineering/definition-of-ready.md': '## Additional AI-Driven Engineering Readiness Checks',
              'engineering/lifecycle/EOSC-change-control.md': '## AI-Driven Replanning and Governing Drift',
              'engineering/lifecycle/EOSE-execution.md': '## AI-Driven Execution Participation',
              'engineering/lifecycle/EOSP-planning.md': '## AI-Driven Planning Participation',
              'engineering/lifecycle/EOSR-review.md': '## AI-Driven Review Participation',
              'engineering/lifecycle/EOSV-verification.md': '## AI-Driven Verification Participation',
              'governance/authority.md': '## AI Actors and Delegated Authority',
              'governance/decision-process.md': '## AI Participation in Decisions',
          }
          dynamic = [
              'governance/planning-engine.md',
              'governance/policy-engine.md',
          ]

          def source_text(file: str) -> str:
              return subprocess.check_output(['git','show',f'{source_ref}:{file}'], text=True)

          def append_section(file: str, heading: str) -> None:
              path = Path(file)
              current = path.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
              if heading in current:
                  return
              src = source_text(file)
              if heading not in src:
                  raise SystemExit(f'missing source heading {heading!r} in {file}')
              section = heading + src.split(heading, 1)[1]
              path.write_text(current.rstrip() + '\n\n' + section.strip() + '\n', encoding='utf-8')

          for file, heading in targets.items():
              append_section(file, heading)

          for file in dynamic:
              src = source_text(file)
              headings = [line for line in src.splitlines() if line.startswith('## AI')]
              if not headings:
                  raise SystemExit(f'no AI section heading found in {file}')
              append_section(file, headings[0])
          PY

      - name: Normalize and validate shared docs
        run: |
          python3 - <<'PY'
          from pathlib import Path
          import subprocess
          changed = subprocess.check_output(['git','diff','--name-only'], text=True).splitlines()
          for raw in changed:
              path = Path(raw)
              if path.suffix != '.md':
                  continue
              text = path.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
              normalized = '\n'.join(line.rstrip(' \t') for line in text.splitlines())
              normalized = normalized.rstrip() + '\n'
              path.write_text(normalized, encoding='utf-8')
          PY
          git diff --check
          grep -q '^### FR-043 — Provide Adaptive AI-Driven Engineering Workflow Planning$' product/product-requirements.md
          grep -q '^### QR-010 — Auditability$' product/product-requirements.md
          grep -q '^## Machine-Traceability Identity Reconciliation$' specifications/baseline.md
          grep -q 'AIENG-TRC-001.*RESOLVED' specifications/baseline.md
          grep -q '^## AI-Driven Planning Participation$' engineering/lifecycle/EOSP-planning.md
          grep -q '^## AI Actors and Delegated Authority$' governance/authority.md

          python3 - <<'PY'
          import subprocess
          allowed = {
            'architecture/decisions/README.md',
            'product/product-requirements.md',
            'specifications/baseline.md',
            'engineering/definition-of-ready.md',
            'engineering/lifecycle/EOSC-change-control.md',
            'engineering/lifecycle/EOSE-execution.md',
            'engineering/lifecycle/EOSP-planning.md',
            'engineering/lifecycle/EOSR-review.md',
            'engineering/lifecycle/EOSV-verification.md',
            'governance/authority.md',
            'governance/decision-process.md',
            'governance/planning-engine.md',
            'governance/policy-engine.md',
          }
          observed = set(subprocess.check_output(['git','diff','--name-only'], text=True).splitlines())
          unexpected = sorted(observed - allowed)
          if unexpected:
              raise SystemExit('unexpected shared-doc changes: ' + ', '.join(unexpected))
          print('shared normative delta boundary: PASS')
          PY

      - name: Commit shared normative integration
        run: |
          git add \
            architecture/decisions/README.md \
            product/product-requirements.md \
            specifications/baseline.md \
            engineering/definition-of-ready.md \
            engineering/lifecycle/EOSC-change-control.md \
            engineering/lifecycle/EOSE-execution.md \
            engineering/lifecycle/EOSP-planning.md \
            engineering/lifecycle/EOSR-review.md \
            engineering/lifecycle/EOSV-verification.md \
            governance/authority.md \
            governance/decision-process.md \
            governance/planning-engine.md \
            governance/policy-engine.md
          git diff --cached --check
          git commit -m "docs(eos): integrate AI-driven operating model on main lineage"

      - name: Publish immutable integration result
        run: git push origin HEAD:refs/heads/automation/aieng-shared-docs-result-20260907
